points.quote: You should only use an artificial intelligence tool to support you in the preparation of work for assessment where your tutors have indicated that its use might be helpful or where it is part of the assessment brief.
points.anchor: Understanding how and when you can use AI
points.gist: Use AI for assessment preparation only where tutors have said it might help or where the assessment brief includes it.

points.quote: If you do use an artificial intelligence tool, you must clearly show which parts of your work have been created by using it and you must describe how you have used the tool.
points.anchor: Understanding how and when you can use AI
points.gist: If you use an AI tool you must show which parts it created and describe how you used it.

points.quote: If you misuse an artificial intelligence tool or fail to declare the use of artificial intelligence in your work and you are later found to have breached the Academic Conduct Policy because of this, the penalties can be serious.
points.anchor: Understanding how and when you can use AI
points.gist: Misusing AI or failing to declare it can breach the Academic Conduct Policy, and penalties can be serious.

points.quote: Please take the time to complete this module before you start any assessment and remember to check your assessment briefs to identify if you are permitted to use AI or ask a tutor if you are unsure.
points.gist: Complete the module before any assessment, and check assessment briefs or ask a tutor if unsure whether AI is permitted.

points.quote: the Academic Conduct and GenAI Declaration tile on the GenAI Literacies Moodle module offers further guidance and step by step instructions about how to check whether you can use GenAI and how to declare its use.
points.gist: The Academic Conduct and GenAI Declaration tile on the Moodle module gives steps for checking whether GenAI is allowed and declaring its use.

points.quote: it is important you follow our guidelines during your time at the University to uphold good academic conduct and learn to use AI responsibly.
points.anchor: Understanding how and when you can use AI
points.gist: Follow the University's guidelines, even if you used AI at a previous institution or workplace.
